SELECT customers.id AS organizationId, IFNULL(customers.name, 'General Customer') AS organizationName, gld.type AS `type`, date AS `date`, (SELECT name FROM companies WHERE id = gld.company_id) AS companyName, reference AS reference, (SELECT CONCAT(account_codes," · ",account_description) FROM chart_accounts WHERE id=gld.chart_account_id) AS accountName, IF(debit > 0, debit * -1, credit) AS amount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = gld.customer_id
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
